name: futeio

scripts.lint: eslint scripts && pnpm --filter @futeio/web lint && pnpm --filter @futeio/mobile lint
scripts.test:unit: node --test scripts/ports.test.mjs scripts/process-group.test.mjs scripts/web-config.test.mjs scripts/firebase-module.test.mjs && node --conditions=react-server --test web/src/server/domain/*.test.ts && pnpm --filter @futeio/web test:unit
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:mobile && pnpm mobile:check && pnpm build && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e

description: Web e mobile privados da pelada, com uma API e dados Firebase compartilhados.
